liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (3 reviews): Jack Straw opened the show with great energy; Jack Straw into Sugaree is called a monumental pairing despite Garcia's shot voice [21][24][27]
- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): Garcia, clearly ailing, still gave Sugaree everything he had [21][27]
- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Shakedown Street is fast and funky, with the drums coming in right on time; The Estimated Prophet into Shakedown Street sequence is singled out as outstanding [22][29]
- **From The Heart Of Me** (1 review): From The Heart Of Me is singled out as making the whole tape worth hearing [24]
- **Ollin Arrageed** (1 other source): Hamza El Din sang and played hand drum, joined by Mickey Hart on drums and hand drum [2]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Fire On The Mountain stands strongly alone, with no Scarlet Begonias before it [29]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 other source): Johnny B. Goode was the encore [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Radio Station Interviews**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [32]
- **Ollin Arrageed**: rare: 14 archived performances [32]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-11-24.pre-fm.miller.87642.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 25 songs; 215 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1978-11-24.151616.prefm.WBUF.blackwood.gems.t.flac1648**: pre-FM broadcast master; 24 songs; 205 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd78-11-24.sbd.prefm.13948.sbefail.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 21 songs; 170 min; rated 4.55/5 by 37 [9]. Said about its sound: This CD copy sounds far better than the reviewer's old tape of the show [23]
- **gd1978-11-24.137575.fm.Browning.flac1644**: FM broadcast; 26 songs; 170 min [2]

## Around the show

- Garcia's voice was creaky, nasal and congested from the start, showing something was wrong [21]
- Hamza El Din joins the band on several tunes [23]
- Garcia had pneumonia and spent ten days in hospital; the following month's shows were cancelled [25]
- The band played on despite Garcia's strained singing because the show was a national radio broadcast [25]
- Garcia's voice was creaky, nasal and congested from the start, showing something was wrong [27]
- An attendee says Garcia was recovering from flu and rumor held that the show would be cancelled [30]
- The show was invitation-only; fans received a letter offering the chance to buy tickets, here first-row seats [31]
- Fans gave roses to Keith; Billy and Mickey stuck some in their cymbal stands [31]
- The reviewer ranks this Shakedown Street above every other version [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-11-24.pre-fm.miller.87642.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: WBCN Pre-FM -> Studer Console -> Master Reel -> Dat/0 (Sony ES/48k) D [1]. Also: Made from master DATs credited to cryptical5, with flaws cleaned up and station IDs removed [1]
- **gd1978-11-24.151616.prefm.WBUF.blackwood.gems.t.flac1648**: source: Recording info: PRE FM > WBUF Reel Master engineered by David LaRussa [3]. Also: Audio mix by David Huett of The Record Plant; some songs and spots patched from a WBCN pre-FM reel [3]
- **gd78-11-24.sbd.prefm.13948.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]. Also: Released as a bootleg LP titled For Dead Heads Only, which left out Ollin Arrageed; Reviewer's old copy was a worn cassette, fifth or sixth generation, found in college in the 1980s; Reviewer first got it around 1980 as a three-disc bootleg, For Dead Heads Only, padded with 1971 material [24][26][29]
- **gd1978-11-24.137575.fm.Browning.flac1644**: transferred by Joey Browning; source: flac16: ; Live FM broadcast > Sony receiver > Sony cassette deck > Maxell 110 XLII, FM Master cassette > CDR's > EAC > wav > Wavelab > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC… [2]

The tour was cancelled after this show because Garcia fell ill, audible in his voice
Johnny B. Goode was the encore
